mapper.insert: INSERT INTO export_jobs ( job_no, status, max_order_id_at_create, idempotency_key, request_hash, filter_count, filter_snapshot, selected_order_ids, selected_columns, requested_file_name, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{jobNo}, #{status}, #{maxOrderIdAtCreate}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestHash}, #{filterCount}, #{filterSnapshot}, #{selectedOrderIds}, #{selectedColumns}, #{requestedFileName}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.sql: id, job_no AS jobNo, status, max_order_id_at_create AS maxOrderIdAtCreate, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, request_hash AS requestHash, filter_count AS filterCount, filter_snapshot AS filterSnapshot, selected_order_ids AS selectedOrderIds, selected_columns AS selectedColumns, requested_file_name AS requestedFileName, version, processed_rows AS processedRows, attempt_count AS attemptCount, error_code AS errorCode, error_message AS errorMessage, file_path AS filePath, file_size_bytes AS fileSizeBytes, expired_at AS expiredAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.update: UPDATE export_jobs SET processed_rows = #{processedRows}, last_heartbeat_at = #{now}, lease_expires_at = #{leaseExpiresAt}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{jobId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND processed_rows <= #{processedRows}

UPDATE export_jobs SET status = 'RUNNING', processed_rows = 0, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, started_at = #{now}, last_heartbeat_at = #{now}, lease_expires_at = #{leaseExpiresAt}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{jobId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND attempt_count < #{maxAttempts}

UPDATE export_jobs SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{jobId} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE export_jobs SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', file_path = #{filePath}, file_size_bytes = #{fileSizeBytes}, finished_at = #{now}, expired_at = #{expiredAt}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{jobId} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE export_jobs SET status = 'PENDING', processed_rows = 0, started_at = NULL, finished_at = NULL, expired_at = NULL, file_path = NULL, file_size_bytes = NULL, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, last_heartbeat_at = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{jobId} AND status = 'FAILED' AND attempt_count < #{maxAttempts}

UPDATE export_jobs SET status = 'FAILED', finished_at = #{now}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, lease_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at <= #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM export_jobs WHERE status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND expired_at IS NOT NULL AND expired_at <= #{now} ORDER BY expired_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE export_jobs SET status = 'EXPIRED', updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{jobId} AND status = 'SUCCEEDED'
